Services

How I help conservation organizations

I bridge the gap between ambitious conservation goals and measurable results. Whether you need a decision-support system, rigorous impact analysis, or strategic execution support—I deliver implementation, not just recommendations.

Decision Support & Data Systems

Build the tools and infrastructure that help your team make better decisions, faster.

### What it is I design and build decision-support dashboards, data systems, and analytical tools that transform raw data into actionable insights for conservation teams. These aren't just visualizations—they're operational systems that integrate into your workflow. ### How it helps ~ **Faster decisions:** Leadership gets real-time access to critical data ~ **Better resource allocation:** Understand where your efforts have the most impact ~ **Reduced manual work:** Automate data collection and reporting processes ~ **Evidence-based strategy:** Ground decisions in data, not just intuition ~ **Stakeholder communication:** Visualize complex data for boards and funders ### What you get ~ Custom dashboards tailored to your KPIs and decision-making needs ~ Data pipeline development (integration with existing systems) ~ Interactive visualizations and reporting tools ~ Documentation and training for your team ~ Ongoing support and iteration as needs evolve ### Who it's for ~ Conservation program managers who need to track multiple initiatives ~ Leadership teams making resource allocation decisions ~ Organizations reporting to boards, donors, or government agencies ~ Teams drowning in spreadsheets who need a better system ### Example projects **Government Decision Tool:** Built a real-time dashboard for UK DEFRA to track policy outcomes during COVID-19, integrating multiple data sources and providing scenario modeling for leadership. **Marine Conservation Monitoring:** Developed an impact tracking system for an international NGO managing 20+ field programs, reducing reporting time by 70% while improving data quality. Program Effectiveness & Impact Analysis

Rigorous analysis to understand what's working, what isn't, and how to improve.

### What it is I conduct statistical analysis and program evaluations to measure the effectiveness of conservation interventions. Using rigorous methodologies, I help you understand whether your programs are achieving their intended impact and how to optimize them. ### How it helps ~ **Prove impact to funders:** Demonstrate results with solid evidence ~ **Optimize program design:** Identify what works and what doesn't ~ **Improve outcomes:** Make data-driven adjustments to increase effectiveness ~ **Build credibility:** Use scientific rigor to strengthen your case ~ **Guide future strategy:** Base new initiatives on proven approaches ### What you get ~ Comprehensive statistical analysis of program outcomes ~ Clear reports translating technical findings for non-technical audiences ~ Visualization of results and key insights ~ Recommendations for program improvement ~ Presentation materials for funders and stakeholders ### Who it's for ~ Organizations needing to prove impact for grant renewals ~ Program managers trying to improve conservation outcomes ~ Leadership teams deciding which programs to scale or sunset ~ Funders wanting to understand return on investment ### Example projects **Marine Protected Area Effectiveness Study:** Analyzed 5 years of ecological and socioeconomic data to assess MPA performance, identifying which management approaches delivered the strongest conservation outcomes. **Community Program Evaluation:** Conducted mixed-methods evaluation of a community-based conservation program, combining statistical analysis with stakeholder interviews to provide actionable recommendations. *[Add 1-2 of your own impact analysis examples here]* Discuss this service

Strategy & Execution

From program strategy to operational delivery—bridging the gap between plan and reality.

### What it is I help organizations develop conservation strategies and then actually execute them. Leadership Advisory

Strategic counsel for conservation leaders navigating complex decisions and organizational change.

### What it is I serve as a trusted advisor to conservation leaders, providing strategic counsel on complex decisions, organizational challenges, and program development. Think of me as an extension of your leadership team—available when you need experienced perspective. ### How it helps ~ **External perspective:** Get objective advice from someone who's been in your shoes ~ **Strategic thinking partner:** Stress-test ideas with someone who understands conservation ~ **Navigate complexity:** Work through difficult decisions with expert guidance ~ **Board preparation:** Develop compelling cases for board and funders ~ **Leadership support:** Have a sounding board for high-stakes decisions ### What you get ~ Regular strategic advisory sessions (scheduled or on-demand) ~ Support for board presentations and funder communications ~ Partnership and negotiation guidance ~ Organizational strategy development ~ Grant writing and fundraising support ~ Access to my network and resources ### Who it's for ~ Executive directors and program directors ~ Conservation organization leadership teams ~ Founders of new conservation initiatives ~ Leaders managing organizational growth or change ~ Anyone feeling isolated in complex decision-making ### Example engagements **Executive Advisory Retainer:** Served as strategic advisor to a conservation nonprofit director during organizational growth, providing monthly counsel on program expansion, fundraising strategy, and partnership development. **Board Preparation Support:** Coached leadership team for critical board presentation on program effectiveness, developing compelling data visualizations and narrative that secured $2M funding renewal. *[Add 1-2 of your own advisory examples here]* Discuss this service
